notes.title: Version 0.1.2 - "The Island Hopper Patch"
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21333631/3bb6db4a464b632ee123ff038fddeb46a12d9972.png

Ahoy there!

We've mostly been working on Antibody lately so we can get it onto the default branch as soon as possible, but we took a brief break from that to update Hamster Slide.

Since this patch was looking like it'd be all small tweaks and minor bug fixes for people who haven't opted into the beta branch, we decided to additionally include a new game mode for Hamster Slide:  "Hopper" mode is for advanced players, and it involves races with only islands, and no track segments - air control and route-finding are crucial in this race type!

This also begs the question:  What other game modes should we add?  The next one we have planned is a longjump style competition, where you launch off a huge ramp and avoid midair obstacles to try to jump and glide as far as possible.

Full patch notes, plus info about how to opt into the beta program and try Antibody early

notes.title: The First Patch! v0.1.1 - Motion Controls and Important Fixes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21333631/da4498580a0efd5fdddacab77eb5ebda5f32b293.png

Our first patch for Observatory is now live!

This patch adds Vive motion controller support for all the existing default-branch content, and it fixes some other stuff, too, including the removal of a super nasty audio stutter in the music video.  The demo version is updated, too!

Full details in the Steam forum

notes.title: Beta testing for first patch: v0.1.1 (Opt-in instantly!)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21333631/3d62b961fbf481dfa42623ddb04f810d4f585b27.png

Our first patch for Observatory is almost entirely made of community-requested changes and fixes.  Thanks for your help!  We're doing a very-quick round of public testing before we set it live on the default branch.

Highlights:
- Vive controller support for music video + racer
- Optimization + big fix for audio stuttering in music video
- Fix for doubled-UI bug on certain menus for Vive
More details and instant-opt-in instructions
